plugins.name: firestorm-avatar
plugins.description: Drive the user's Second Life avatar via the embedded Firestorm MCP server — inventory, appearance, profiles, search, groups, uploads, nearby-avatar inspection, in-world chat + RLV relays. Bundles the three firestorm-* skills and the MCP connection.

plugins.name: mpsearch
plugins.description: Search the Second Life Marketplace — listings, copy/modify/transfer permissions, reviews, creator stores and the category tree. Bundles a dependency-free MCP server, the marketplace-search skill, and a session-capture command.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Reusable role agents — a product owner (shape, guard, cut), an autonomous senior developer (ship-ready: verified, signed, pushed, PR), a QA verifier (verify, plan, break), a designer (explore, refine, critique), and a changelog editor (cut, curate, review) — sharing the work-queue handoff protocol so they can be called solo or chained into an autonomous loop.

plugins.name: travel-team
plugins.description: Five travel-planning role agents — a gem-scout (locals-only, off-path finds), a mustsee-scout (the popular-but-worth-it canon, plus an honest skip list), a bookings agent (what sells out and how far ahead it really books), a food agent (street food to book-ahead tables, grouped by neighborhood), and a concierge (merges whatever briefs exist into one dossier) — sharing the trip-dossier skill so their sourced research composes into a loose menu of a trip, not an hour-by-hour itinerary.

plugins.name: post-file
plugins.description: Upload files to files.th3a.dev and get a shareable link back. Folders with an index.html post as live site previews. Markdown is rendered to a designed, self-contained HTML page first (via frontend-design) so the link opens as a page instead of downloading as a file.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: A port of Lauren Tan's pstack (MIT, from cursor/plugins) to Claude Code. /bro restates the last message in plain language, /unslop strips AI tells from prose, /no-comments sends the Comment Sicko agent through a diff to delete comments and fix the code that made them necessary. Ships the whole dependency cone those three pull in: architect, arena, how, why, interrogate, show-me-your-work and 14 principle skills, rewired to the Agent tool and Claude Code model pools.

plugins.name: ste100
plugins.description: Write and audit documentation in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, the controlled language used for aerospace and defence technical publications. Carries all 53 writing rules of Issue 9 and the eight general recommendations, keyed to their real rule numbers, plus a word-choice reference for software documentation — including the technical-verb category that makes click, delete, install and validate legal STE, which naive guides get wrong.
